title: macOS CI via SDK relay implementation
desc: Procedure and implementation details for macOS portable .NET build validation
steps: GitHub receives dispatch: workflow_dispatch from web UI or repository_dispatch via gh workflow run command
Workflow executes on macos-latest runner: .NET 8.0.x pre-installed by setup-dotnet action
Access control: WKAPPBOT_CORE_PAT secret (GitHub personal access token) clones kiexpert/WKAppBot private core with depth=1 for minimal download
Shell: bash used throughout for cross-platform compatibility (macOS native shell)
Token hygiene: GH_TOKEN env var passed to git clone command but never echoed to logs or console
Conditional build: checks if wkab/csharp/Portable.slnf exists before attempting dotnet build
Build command: dotnet build Portable.slnf -f net8.0 -v q redirects output to build_output.log for review
Success path: exit code 0 prints checkmark, echoes Build completed successfully
Failure path: exit code non-zero prints X, echoes Build failed with exit code N, tails last 20 lines of log file
Not-yet-available path: Portable.slnf missing, graceful exit 0 with no error (not a failure)
Public log location: GitHub Actions tab shows full logs but sensitive data (token, paths) stripped by wkappbot secret-masking policy
To test locally: clone repo, run dotnet build csharp/Portable.slnf -f net8.0 -v q if file exists

Verified Execution (2026-09-30): workflow_dispatch trigger confirmed working (run 36664055544, success in 41 seconds). Repository_dispatch API support wired; requires specific GitHub API client_payload JSON format per API spec.

requirements.expect: exit 0 on success or non-zero on build error
